stories.title: Anthropic files S-1 prospectus for Nasdaq IPO under ticker ANT
stories.summary: Anthropic filed its S-1 with the SEC to go public on Nasdaq as ANT, disclosing financials, risks, and a governance structure meant to preserve founder control and its safety mission.
stories.more: Anthropic filed its S-1 prospectus with the SEC, confirming plans to list on the Nasdaq exchange under the ticker "ANT" and beat OpenAI to a public listing. The filing discloses soaring revenue alongside mounting losses, major enterprise adoption, and a governance structure built to preserve founder control and the company's safety mission. In the prospectus, Anthropic lays out a plan it says could "revolutionize every area of human endeavor" with AI, while also describing a "closing the loop" strategy it frames as both AI's best path to success and a source of "existential" risk. The filing drew heavy attention, with a Hacker News discussion of the S-1 document reaching 880 points and 792 comments. Full financial details and risk factors are laid out in the prospectus itself, which was filed on Monday.

stories.title: Microsoft offers buyouts to up to 60,000 employees
stories.summary: Microsoft is offering voluntary buyouts to as many as 60,000 employees in the US, UK, Canada, and India, as it looks to trim staff without further layoffs.
stories.more: Chief people officer Amy Coleman told staff the buyout program gives employees "the opportunity to leave Microsoft with financial support and career planning resources." The offer is voluntary and spans the US, UK, Canada, and India. Microsoft is framing it as a way to reduce headcount without resorting to another round of layoffs. The excerpt does not specify how many employees are expected to take the offer or its cost to the company.

stories.title: Quantized DeepSeek V4.1 Flash GGUF trends on Hugging Face
stories.summary: A GGUF-quantized build of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash from ISTA-DASLab is trending on Hugging Face, with 891,147 downloads and 329 likes.
stories.more: The model, uploaded by ISTA-DASLab, applies GSQ/RCO mixed-precision quantization to compress DeepSeek's V4.1 Flash mixture-of-experts model into GGUF format for local inference. It has drawn 891,147 downloads and 329 likes on Hugging Face, and is tagged as a text-generation, conversational model. The listing references two arXiv papers (2604.18556 and 2605.00649), though the repository card gives no further detail on the quantization method or benchmark results.

stories.title: OpenAI pitches AI models as fix for legacy COBOL code crisis
stories.summary: The Verge examines whether OpenAI's latest AI models, touted for "substantial improvements" announced October 19th, can help migrate legacy COBOL systems still running critical infrastructure.
stories.more: The piece notes that institutions including the IRS, banks, airlines, and government agencies still depend on decades-old COBOL code that few are willing to touch. OpenAI says it has made "substantial improvements" in its latest AI models for this kind of legacy-code migration, announced October 19th. The article frames this as OpenAI's attempt to position its models as a solution to a long-standing problem in enterprise software maintenance. It does not detail specific benchmark results or name which OpenAI model is involved.

stories.title: Tesla pivots from EV sales to autonomy and AI software for profit
stories.summary: Ars Technica reports Tesla is shifting strategy toward autonomy subscriptions and AI software, betting they can deliver profit margins that EV sales alone cannot.

It frames autonomy subscriptions as a potential new profit engine, offering margins that traditional car sales cannot match. No specific financial figures or timelines are given in the excerpt.

stories.title: Kevin Roose talks AI industry shift in new book The AGI Chronicles
stories.summary: The Verge's Decoder podcast interviews journalist Kevin Roose about his new book The AGI Chronicles, which chronicles the AI industry's recent transformation.
stories.more: Kevin Roose, a longtime New York Times reporter, wrote The AGI Chronicles about the industry's recent and "explosive" transformation. He previously co-hosted the podcast Hard Fork with Casey Newton before both left to pursue new projects. The episode title frames Roose as now believing in the near-term plausibility of AGI, describing him as "AGI-pilled."
